blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — A new 40-bed shelter near the Vicente Sotto Memorial Medical Center (VSMMC) is now ready to accommodate patients’ watchers needing a place to rest overnight. The Pasilongan Center, located along Don Mariano Street in Cebu City, provides temporary accommodation for companions who cannot stay within hospital premises because of space limitations. The Cebu Provincial Government inaugurated the facility on Monday afternoon, Oct. 26, 2026, with operations set to begin on Tuesday, Oct. 27. READ: Watchers sleeping outside?
